{"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-16 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. v2 rows are therefore shifted +6h: for example, 12:03 appears where legacy would show 06:03. This pushes late-evening local transactions into the next date, which explains the 33 rows for 01-19 and the 00:00-06:00 timestamps. The fix converts v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       local_ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN collector = 'v2'
              THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP)
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)
         END AS local_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
) s;"}}
